name: Propulsion-Only Partial Failure & Capability Preservation
description: Demonstrates core ASTRANET capability-loss reasoning (Master Blueprint v2.0 Section 3.1 & 15.4). Instead of binary alive/dead node replacement, SAT-03 in Plane A suffers moderate propulsion degradation (cold-gas valve leak) at t=2.0s. Active orbital maneuvering is disabled, but SAT-03 remains an operational Earth-observation sensor, high-throughput relay, compute node, and storage buffer. The constellation avoids wasteful node ejection, preserves observation schedules, and maintains nominal ISL links without manual intervention.

scheduled_faults.description: Cold-gas thruster valve leak on SAT-03 in Plane A disabling active maneuvering
